project.name: Pert
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition settlement gate. Nearby attractions, estates and neighbouring settlements do not inflate the place score. Score corrected after removal of the artificial sub-60 catalogue gate. Settlement merit was assessed before applying the map threshold; standalone attractions were not transferred into the town score. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
